result.markdown:
# Traffic Down and Latency Up at S-SFX-009

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_degradation at `LNK-SFX-01-B`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct evidence of a major link degradation alarm on the shared transport link matching the exact window of KPI anomalies; maintenance and changes were checked and ruled out. External events: NOT CHECKED (no tool call made).)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-26 19:30 to 2026-09-26 23:07
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-26 19:20
- **Affected:** S-SFX-009, S-SFX-002, S-SFX-010

## Summary

Transport degradation on microwave link LNK-SFX-01-B caused by a major LINK_DEGRADED alarm, impacting traffic and latency across connected sites.

Traffic volume dropped and latency increased at S-SFX-009 and sibling sites S-SFX-002 and S-SFX-010 starting around 19:30 on 2026-09-26 and recovering by 23:07 when the link alarm cleared.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-26 19:20: Major alarm ALM-000604 LINK_DEGRADED raised on microwave link LNK-SFX-01-B. [ALM-000604, T4]
- 2026-09-26 19:30: Earliest onset of KPI deviations (latency spike and traffic drop) observed at S-SFX-009 and sibling sites S-SFX-002 and S-SFX-010. [T1, T3, T7, ALR-0034]
- 2026-09-26 23:07: Alarm ALM-000604 cleared on LNK-SFX-01-B, marking the end of the impact. [ALM-000604, T4]

## Evidence

- S-SFX-009 experienced traffic volume drops and latency increases starting at 2026-09-26 19:30. [T1, T3]
- A major LINK_DEGRADED alarm (ALM-000604) occurred on microwave link LNK-SFX-01-B from 2026-09-26 19:20 to 23:07. [ALM-000604, T4]
- Sibling sites S-SFX-002 and S-SFX-010 sharing the same transport path also experienced latency increases and traffic drops beginning at 2026-09-26 19:30. [T2, T7]
- No maintenance windows or configuration changes were scheduled or performed on S-SFX-009, LNK-SFX-01-B, or AGG-SFX-01 during the incident window. [T5, T6]

## Inferences

- The transport degradation on LNK-SFX-01-B caused the observed performance degradation across all connected sites. [T2, T4, T7]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_degradation** at LNK-SFX-01-B: confirmed. Direct evidence of major link degradation alarm ALM-000604 starting just prior to the KPI anomaly onset, affecting the shared microwave link for S-SFX-009, S-SFX-002, and S-SFX-010, with full recovery upon alarm clearing. [T2, T4, T7, ALM-000604]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000605: Minor VSWR_HIGH alarm on S-SFX-006 occurred later (22:40 to 22:55) and cleared before the end of the incident, and does not match the simultaneous onset across multiple sites.
- ALM-000606: Minor VSWR_HIGH alarm on S-SFX-006 occurred at 23:18 after the main transport degradation had already cleared.
- ALM-000607: Minor VSWR_HIGH alarm on S-SFX-006 occurred at 23:34 after recovery.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect microwave link LNK-SFX-01-B for potential physical or environmental interference that triggered the LINK_DEGRADED alarm.
